name: binomial_low_base_rate_exact
description: One-sample exact binomial test at a low base rate p0=0.01 vs p1=0.03, one-sided greater, alpha=0.05, 80% power. Expected success counts are far below 5, so AUTO rejects the normal approximation and switches to the exact binomial test; minimal n=301 (n=300 gives 0.79737 and fails).

reference.provenance: Independent enumeration of the exact Binomial(n,p) critical region with scipy.stats.binom
